data.name: Arcanefall : Darklands
data.detailed_description:
Arcanefall: Darklands is a dark fantasy survivor-like game where you take on

the role of a spellcaster fighting to survive endless waves of undead horrors

in a cursed, crumbling world.

Choose your caster. Six unique wizards await. Each with their own combat

style, exclusive passive ability, and signature spell. Master the balanced

arcane bolts of the Wizard, unleash devastating fire with the Flame Witch,

or command the icy resilience of the Frost Mage.

Survive the onslaught. Waves of skeletal warriors, ranged cultists, and

flesh-hungry ghouls grow stronger and more numerous with every passing minute.

Build your build. Level up mid-battle and choose from dozens of evolving

skills like chain lightning, orbiting arcane orbs, piercing volleys, and more.

Combine and evolve your abilities to create devastating build synergies

unique to every run.

Unlock and progress. Earn coins from every run to unlock new playable

characters, each with their own strengths and playstyle.

FEATURES:

- 6 unique playable spellcasters, each with an exclusive passive skill

- Dozens of skills and evolutions to combine into unique builds

- Escalating enemy waves with melee, ranged, and boss-tier threats

- Repeating boss encounters that scale in difficulty the longer you survive

- Full controller-friendly and mouse-driven combat

- Persistent progression — unlock characters across runs
